query:
UPDATE exercise_slide_submission_shares
SET deleted_at = now()
WHERE exercise_answer_snapshot_id IN (
    SELECT id
    FROM exercise_answer_snapshots
    WHERE user_id = $1
      AND course_id = $2
      AND (
        $3::uuid [] IS NULL
        OR exercise_id = ANY($3)
      )
  )
  AND deleted_at IS NULL
